kind: N06 CLI input/output isolation repair; no new visual acceptance

historical_defect.source_fixture: Owned non-Git plain copy of exactly 285 unchanged plus seven changed-host receipt inputs; no canonical inputs modified
historical_defect.cause: The old CLI excluded the evidence package and Git output ancestors, but never protected the --repository root before output creation.
historical_defect.temporary_directory_risk: The old default called tempfile.TemporaryDirectory without a preflight; parent selection may probe-write before returning.

repair: Normalize and reject symlink/traversal input roots before any output creation; --repository must exist and be a directory.
Reject explicit outputs equal to, within, or covering the package or entire source root, including non-Git trees; retain Git and output-pair exclusions.
Choose the prospective automatic child without tempfile probe writes; validate it and the report before mkdir. First nonempty TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP, otherwise /tmp, fails closed if unusable.
Create automatic work privately (0700 subject to umask), and remove only that created directory after success or validation error. Preserve explicit work-directory behavior.

bounded_regression.assurance: Each CLI rejection exits 1 with no write audit events, unchanged file/link/directory fixture inventory and no requested outputs. Covers protected roots, descendants, ancestors, aliases, Git, existing outputs, traversal, missing/non-directory sources, TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP, optimization and FIFO. Separate tests cover safe common temporary parent, automatic report/work overlap, cleanup and private permissions.

unchanged_scope: Original ZIP members, all 28 raw JPEGs, historical capture/current-input receipts, numerical replay algorithms and all runtime/release files remain byte-identical. The CLI isolation defect does not invalidate the historical rendered observations; native rendering and Java Font limits remain unchanged.

base_reuse.scope: The exact tested five-file delta was applied to current main. Only this base-reuse metadata and its direct artifact checksum were refreshed afterward. Prior test logs remain unchanged; independent review is pending.
